cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "http://example.com/schema.json" and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode.
cases.description: Typical usage – a well‑formed absolute URI and a valid JSON schema node. The method should create a JsonSchema via newJsonSchema and return it.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "file:///tmp/my-schema.yaml" and whose root node is an empty ObjectNode.
cases.description: URI points to a file scheme and the JSON node is an empty object. The method must still forward the values unchanged.

group: Null or missing parameters – exceptional paths

cases.description: When the URI argument is null the call to schemaUri.toString() throws NPE. The method should not swallow the exception.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose root node is null (the factory must accept a null JsonNode).
cases.description: The JSON node may be null – the factory forwards it to newJsonSchema which is allowed to handle a null schema node.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException or URISyntaxException wrapped in RuntimeException
cases.description: A syntactically invalid URI string causes SchemaLocation.of(...) to fail. The method should propagate the exception.

cases.expected: A JsonSchema whose internal SchemaValidatorsConfig reflects the default configuration returned by createSchemaValidatorsConfig().
cases.description: Even though getSchema does not expose the config, we verify that the factory uses the default config by inspecting a known behaviour (e.g., a custom format validator is not enabled).

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "schemas/myschema.json" and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode.
cases.description: A relative URI (no scheme) should be accepted; the method forwards the string unchanged to SchemaLocation.of and returns a schema whose location matches the relative path.

group: URI with fragment and query parameters

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation exactly matches the full URI including query and fragment, and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode.
cases.description: Ensures that the method does not strip query strings or fragments; the full URI string is used as the schema location.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "https://example.org/complex-schema.json" and whose root node equals the supplied complex JsonNode.
cases.description: Verifies that the factory can handle a deeply nested, realistic schema without altering its structure.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "http://example.com/array-schema.json" and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode representing an array schema.
cases.description: Checks that the method does not require the supplied JsonNode to be an object; array‑type schemas are accepted.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "http://example.com/string-schema.json" and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode representing a primitive string schema.
cases.description: Ensures that a schema describing a primitive type (string) is passed through unchanged.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "http://example.com/missing-node.json" and whose root node is a Jackson MissingNode (indicating a missing schema definition).
cases.description: Jackson's MissingNode is a special JsonNode subclass; the factory should forward it to newJsonSchema without throwing.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation exactly matches the percent‑encoded URI string and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode.
cases.description: Validates that the method does not decode or otherwise modify percent‑encoded characters in the URI.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is "classpath:/schemas/internal-schema.json" and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode.
cases.description: Even though the scheme 'classpath' is not a standard URL scheme, the method treats the URI as a plain string; it should still create a schema instance without error.

cases.expected: A non‑null JsonSchema instance whose SchemaLocation is an empty string and whose root node equals the supplied JsonNode.
cases.description: An empty string is a syntactically valid (relative) URI; the method should accept it and propagate it unchanged to SchemaLocation.
